title: Goal round 1 — resume-chained survival pressure with the LEARNING mind (continuity AND food/water, both)
source: operator 2026-08-05T04:41Z: 'we can do both. do the continuity AND the food and water pressure' — the learning-mind deployment decision plus the convene-ratified goal content
description: The first goal-directed round: resume-chained short turns on Orwell (continuity, proven machinery) running the LEARNING mind (world-train.js, G-MIND-LEARNING-REVIEW cleared) under a food/water survival-pressure goal packet with an independently evaluable predicate and deadline, thresholds DERIVED from the continuity-control and baseline data. Expected side effect (the convergence): genuine scarcity brings encoder coord 7 (starvation pressure) alive, completing the mind's masked curriculum — the ecology and the education are the same event.

overlap_disposition.decision: new plan (a round definition), riding both owners' cleared gates
overlap_disposition.stated_reason: Both prerequisite plans are complete and gate-cleared; this plan defines ONE round's goal packet + turn sequence and adds no new engine or contract surface.

hard_constraints: Goal packet per convene synthesis: independently evaluable predicate + explicit deadline; thresholds derived from observed data (cc turns + baselines), never invented
Resume-chained turns (the proven -ResumeFrom lineage); halt-for-repair law unchanged
Zero-NIC membrane, courier contract, sanitized-projection-only harvests unchanged
Mirror-safety: the goal evaluator reads STOCKPILE/ecology numbers only — never build coordinates or feature positions (the goal must not bribe the mirror any more than the learning signal may)
watch-turn-health beside every turn; confound test runs on every harvest with the D1 applicability predicate

ONE-WAY EVALUATOR ISOLATION (codex F1): the goal evaluator's output flows ONLY to reports/projection — by construction it runs in the post-tick REPORTING path of run-live.js, after all decisions and updates for the tick are complete, and NOTHING in the world-mind, hive, or world-train call graphs reads its output (verified by call-graph audit in S1 evidence). Hunger may change behavior through the WORLD (stockpiles the mind already perceives); the goal's evaluation may not. This is what makes hunger-driven building emergence rather than evaluator-induced confounding.

steps.title: Goal packet design (thresholds from data)
steps.description: Derive the predicate from the record: baselines show food ~0-4.7, water ~3.8-15.6, wood 0, prey ~0.5-1.7, both hives alive with stockpiles above zero. Draft goal packet: schema GoalPacket/1.0 {goal_id, predicate (machine-evaluable over the sanitized world-state: e.g. combined food stockpile >= F AND water >= W AND both hives non-extinct at deadline), deadline_absolute_day, safety_bounds (no new verb powers; evaluator read-only), evaluator_version, derivation (each threshold cites the observed datum it derives from)}. The evaluator is a small pure function over world-state.json shipped in the payload; its output joins the sanitized projection. F/W thresholds: challenging but reachable per the observed dynamics — derivation shown, reviewed, not asserted. NUMERIC DERIVATION CONTRACT (codex F2): every threshold ships as {value, units, formula, source_field (exact world-state path), aggregation_scope (per-hive vs combined; which ticks), derivation_datum (the observed number and its artifact)} — and a REACHABILITY test: the S1 rehearsal must demonstrate measurable progress toward (not necessarily attainment of) each threshold under the no-goal control dynamics, or the threshold is re-derived. GoalPacket/1.0 carries sha256 of the packet body; the evaluator ships with its own version + hash. Checkpoint generations during goal turns carry the goal identity (goal_id + packet hash) in the manifest's goal fields — no more goal:null on goal-directed runs (codex r2).

steps.title: Local goal-round rehearsal
steps.description: Full local rehearsal before Orwell: 3 resume-chained 150-tick turns with the learning mind + goal packet in the sandbox. Verify: goal evaluator runs and reports honestly (met/unmet with the measured values); coord 7 liveness ACTIVATES if any hive crosses the stockpile line (the convergence made measurable — report whether it did); learning continues across resumes (loss trajectory spans turns); contamination alarm stays quiet; mirror confound test clean. Evidence: goal-round-rehearsal-evidence.json. REHEARSAL CONTRACT (codex F4): arms = GOAL (3 chained turns with packet) vs CONTROL (3 chained turns, no packet, same seeds) — the behavioral delta IS the goal's measured effect; evaluator TRACE recorded per tick (inputs read, output, proof it ran post-decision); TAMPER probe (packet hash mismatch -> refusal before boot); passthrough validation (job.env goal fields regex-validated host-side); evidence as GoalRoundRehearsalEvidence/1.0 {arms, evaluator_trace_digest, isolation_call_graph_audit, tamper_result, coord7_events, lineage_chain, confound_results, overall_verdict}. COORD-7 OPERATIONALIZED (codex F5): activation = coord 7 nonzero on >= 1 tick (i.e., any hive_state.stockpile <= 0 event, the encoder's own predicate); the activation window and per-tick series are recorded; activation is an ECOLOGY measurement enabling future learning on that coordinate — explicitly NOT itself a learning or convergence claim.

steps.title: Codex trial + operator packet
steps.description: Distinct trial of goal evaluator + packet + rehearsal evidence (G-GOAL-ROUND-REVIEW). Then the G-REMOTE-MUTATION packet for the operator's fresh stamp (recorded conditional stamp below covers it if conditions hold): payload rebuild (learning mind + evaluator), deploy via the hardened path, 3+ resume-chained 150-tick goal turns on Orwell, per-turn harvest -> dashboard + Unreal imports, watch-turn-health throughout.

steps.title: Run, harvest, debrief — then /meditate
steps.description: Execute on Orwell under the stamp; harvest every turn; the science readout: goal progress, coord-7 activation, loss trajectory across resumes, mirror-p trajectory WITH confound checks, behavioral divergence vs the frozen-mind cc turns. Debrief. Per the standing cadence, this round's completion triggers a /meditate over everything the minds' actions taught.

Escalation: any evaluator input touching build/feature coordinates; any packet field crossing the courier beyond the sanitized surfaces
